headline: Taxation of international parcels: the government has re-approved a package of bills
summary: Ukraine's Cabinet of Ministers re-approved two draft laws on taxing small postal and express shipments valued up to 150, according to the report dated September 7.
why: Changes to import taxes on low-value parcels affect e-commerce retailers and logistics operators that ship goods into Ukraine. The rules also shape the cost of cross-border online purchases.
